name: KimoraPro Hotel Booking
author: kimorapro

sections.description:
Core Free manages room types and guest reservations for one hotel property/site. Guests can book offline without Pro, WooCommerce, an account or a paid theme.

Included in Core Free

Rooms and pages

  • Base prices, physical room quantities and guest capacity; optional area, beds, views, amenities and Media Library images. Descriptive attributes do not change capacity/inventory. Rooms work without photos.
  • Room catalogue and separate dated availability results; availability/price are rechecked before saving.
  • Rooms/Booking Page provisioning/assignment; homepage/navigation remain yours.
  • Room Detail SEO: optional per-room SEO title/description, canonical link, Schema.org JSON-LD and a room sitemap. Active SEO plugins keep their own meta tags and sitemap.

Bookings and payments

  • Guest booking, protected confirmation, stored room/night/price snapshots and staff management. Saved can mean pending/unpaid.
  • Book Now asks for the booker’s Country/Region of residence. Staff see it on the booking and in the new-booking email; it is never guessed from IP, language or phone number.
  • Pay at hotel, staff records of payments received, and Core tax calculation from settings. Free does not execute online payments.
  • Optional display currencies: guests can view estimated prices in another currency they choose. Bookings, payments, emails and invoices always stay in the site currency.
  • Book Now always shows the actual amount to pay. Exchange rates are entered by hand or, if you opt in, updated daily (see External services).
  • Coupons and vouchers: percentage or fixed discounts on the room subtotal, optionally limited by dates, stay length, minimum amount, rooms or room types, total uses and uses per guest. Guests apply a code on Book Now; staff see every use under Coupon Usage.

Emails, forms and privacy

  • Basic customer/staff mail through WordPress transport/queue. Free customer email has details/contact information, no View My Bookings/account CTA.
  • Optional Contact, double-opt-in Newsletter/unsubscribe (not campaigns), and no-photo demo data.
  • Native WordPress privacy export/erasure, with eligible, retained and manual cases.

Optional Hotel Booking Pro — separate paid add-on

Pro supplies supported:

  • Advanced pricing, Additional Services and advanced taxes.
  • Online/WooCommerce integrations.
  • Accounts/My Booking and cancellation/refund operations.
  • PDF invoices, calendar/CSV and iCal availability blocks.
  • Reviews and email automation.

Compatible versions, entitlement, configuration and sometimes external accounts/WooCommerce are required.

Manual/staff refund records differ from supported gateway execution; not all gateways automatically refund. iCal blocks are not a full OTA rates/content channel manager or partner certification.

KimoraPro themes are separate optional products.

Pages and shortcodes

  • [kimorapro_hb_rooms] — Free catalogue, not dated search results.
  • [kimorapro_hb_booking] — Free booking/search entry.
  • [kimorapro_hb_contact] — optional Free Contact after readiness setup.
  • [kimorapro_hb_subscribe] — optional Free Newsletter after enabling intake.
  • [kimorapro_hb_currency_switcher] — optional display-currency selector; shown only while a display currency is enabled.
  • [hotel_booking_account] — Pro only; not an account feature in Free.

Use assigned Page View links. Search uses /search-availability/; existing detail/Book Now/confirmation links can use /rooms/ fallback. Prefer generated URLs and keep signed links private.

Privacy

Guest/contact, stay, correspondence and financial/operational records live in the site database. WordPress mail can send recipients/content to the operator’s provider.

Optional Pro license/update, gateway and iCal services exchange required data when configured, and the optional exchange-rate service sends only currency codes (see External services); WordPress/other plugins can make separate requests.

Free offline booking needs no Pro service. Data is not guaranteed to stay on-site.

Tools → Export Personal Data / Erase Personal Data uses booking guest-email matching: local-part/plus-tag preserved, ASCII domain case folded, no account-email union. Active bookings can export.

Erasure redacts eligible direct identifiers/notes and detaches account links; cancelled/checked-out cases need current review and no unresolved obligations/holds.

Active, no-show, ambiguous/external and unresolved financial cases are retained/manual. Financial/reference/audit and signed/issued records can remain linkable.

This is not blanket anonymization, user deletion or booking-token revocation.

Queue protection prevents new mail after redaction; in-flight work can defer erasure. Sent mail, external copies and backups need separate handling.

No booking retention days or automatic purge is introduced. Contact/Newsletter use separate configured lifecycle settings.

Deactivation preserves data; communication-only uninstall removal does not erase bookings/payments/invoices.

Code recovery cannot restore erased data. Operators set lawful retention and their own Privacy Policy; no compliance guarantee is made.

Services and source

Mail destinations are operator-configured; consult the actual enabled provider’s terms/privacy policy. A test sink or sales policy is not the hotel’s policy. Free requires no gateway account.

Readable PHP, JavaScript/CSS and translation sources are included under GPLv2 or later. Composer autoload maps carry vendor/composer/LICENSE (complete MIT notice) and build provenance in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

Supplementary build/support docs are delivered separately; no private repository or unpublished website is offered as an available public link.

External services

Frankfurter exchange rates (optional, off by default). Display currencies let guests view estimated prices in another currency; bookings and payments always stay in the site’s base currency. Rates can be entered by hand.

The plugin contacts Frankfurter (https://api.frankfurter.dev) only if an administrator enables “Automatic updates” under Hotel Booking → Settings → Currency.

It then requests reference rates once a day through WP-Cron and whenever an administrator clicks “Update rates now”.

  • Data sent: the base currency code and the codes of the enabled display currencies (for example base=VND&quotes=USD,EUR). No visitor, guest, booking, site address or account data is sent, and the request identifies only the plugin.
  • When: never while automatic updates are off. Turning them off, deactivating or uninstalling the plugin removes the schedule.
  • Terms of use: https://frankfurter.dev/license/
  • Privacy (Frankfurter FAQ, “What is the privacy policy of the API?”): https://frankfurter.dev/#faq
sections.installation:
Set up

  1. Plugins → Add Plugin → Upload Plugin: choose the ZIP, install and activate. Open Hotel Booking → Get started.
  2. In Settings, save the hotel profile and Hotel Currency. Currency changes do not convert old prices/bookings.
  3. Rooms → Add New: enter code/name/type, Base Price, Max Adults/Children, Quantity and Available status; save. Quantity counts physical rooms. Attributes, amenities and photos are optional.
  4. In Settings, inspect Rooms/Booking page and their View links. Choose another page or Create/Retry if needed. Assignment preserves content/status. Add navigation yourself.

Test a booking

  1. Payment Settings: enable Pay at hotel and save. On Booking Page, choose dates/guests, Check availability, View Details, Book now; enter guest details and submit Book Now.
  2. Check confirmation code, saved stay/total and status. In Bookings open that code, inspect items/nights/payment summary. Confirm/Record Payment only when hotel operations allow it.
  3. Check customer/staff emails with your mail transport/cron. Contact, Newsletter and demo are optional. No build tools/database commands are needed.

Updating

Back up files/database for updates. For updates already using kimorapro-hotel-booking, replace that same folder; do not Delete/uninstall.

Migrating a legacy hotel-booking installation requires a backed-up maintenance transition: deactivate, quarantine the legacy files outside the plugins directory and webroot, install this package, then activate.

Existing Pages, settings and booking data are retained; align the separate Pro dependency before reactivation. Use a compatible separate Pro add-on when needed.
sections.faq:
Does Free require Pro, WooCommerce, an account or a paid theme?

No. Free supports offline guest reservations for one property/site. Customer accounts and online integrations are Pro only. Not every theme/page builder or multisite combination is certified.

Why are catalogue and search results different?

Catalogue describes room types; search filters dates, guests, capacity, inventory and blocks. Quantity counts physical rooms, not guest capacity. No photo is needed.

For no results, check room status/quantity/capacity and try different dates or guests.

Is a saved booking paid or confirmed?

Not necessarily. Pay at hotel collects no online funds. Check booking and ledger-derived payment status separately; staff records only money received. Booking email is not proof of payment. Pro pricing/gateways require their supported setup.

Why is there no View My Bookings button in Free email?

Account access is Pro only; current Free emails intentionally omit that CTA. Older queued/delivered emails may differ. Do not bulk rewrite/resend history for appearance. Keep the booking code and contact the hotel.

What if mail is missing or a form expires?

Check saved hotel email, WordPress transport, queue/cron, hosting logs and spam. Successful transport does not guarantee inbox delivery. Base mail needs no Pro license.

Check whether a booking was saved before reloading/retrying an expired form. Availability can change; do not disable nonce/privacy protections or force a paid status.

What if a Page is renamed, trashed or private?

Inspect assignment/status in Settings. Restore through WordPress or choose an appropriate published Page with the shortcode. Private/password Pages are not public entry points.

Assignment preserves content/status; it does not rebuild arbitrary content. Use Create/Retry when offered, not routine permalink saves/server restarts.

How do optional communication and demo modules work?

In Newsletter & Contact, Contact needs enabled intake, a saved recipient, privacy notice and valid Privacy Policy URL; the suggested admin address is not saved automatically. Contact Page readiness is separate.

Newsletter intake needs enabling, then double opt-in; unsubscribe is supported, campaigns are not.

Demo Data has no photos. Review ownership-aware removal; do not delete unrelated hotel data.

Where can I get help or report a vulnerability?

For help with the Free plugin, use the WordPress.org support forum. Include your plugin and theme versions, steps to reproduce the issue, what happened, and what you expected. Remove guest data, cookies, credentials and signed URLs.

For general inquiries or to arrange a private vulnerability report, email service@kimorapro.com.
sections.changelog:
3.32.0

  • New: Coupons and vouchers are now part of Core Free (they were in Hotel Booking Pro). Create percentage or fixed-amount codes under Hotel Booking → Coupons and limit them by dates, stay length, minimum booking amount, rooms or room types, total uses and uses per guest.
  • Guests apply a code on Book Now; the discount applies to the room subtotal, is checked again when the booking is saved, and every use is listed under Coupon Usage.
  • Existing coupons and their usage history are kept; there is nothing to re-enter. Hotel Booking Pro 1.40.0 and older keep running coupons until Pro is updated.
  • Fixed: on sites without Hotel Booking Pro, a booking that used a coupon (for example the demo booking) could not change status.
  • Improved: coupon screens and messages in Vietnamese, French, Italian and German.
  • Developer: coupon entry points use the kimorapro_hb_ / kimorapro-hb- prefix (for example the kimorapro_hb_coupon_preview AJAX action and the kimorapro-hb-frontend-coupons script). No database schema change.

See changelog.txt in the plugin package for earlier releases.

upgrade_notice.3.32.0: Coupons and vouchers move into Core Free; existing coupons and their history are kept and no database change is made. If you use Hotel Booking Pro, it keeps managing coupons until you update it to a release that requires Core Free 3.32.0.
upgrade_notice.3.31.0: Adds optional display currencies and automatic exchange rates; both stay off until you enable them under Hotel Booking → Settings → Currency. No database change. Hotel Booking Pro 1.39.0 is the tested pair.
upgrade_notice.3.30.0: Adds Country/Region of residence to Book Now and a small automatic database update. Back up before updating, keep the same plugin folder and update Hotel Booking Pro to 1.38.0 if you use it.
upgrade_notice.3.29.0: Adds Room Detail SEO and a small automatic database update. Back up before updating, keep the same plugin folder and update Hotel Booking Pro to a compatible version if you use it.
upgrade_notice.3.28.0: First release on WordPress.org. If you used an earlier KimoraPro package, back up first, keep the same plugin folder and do not uninstall to upgrade. Update Hotel Booking Pro to a compatible version if you use it.

Free room editor showing bed/view attributes, base price, guest capacity and room quantity.
Availability results for the selected stay and guest counts, separate from the room catalogue.
Room detail with the existing no-photo fallback and booking entry.
Guest booking form with the Free Pay at hotel method.
Mobile booking confirmation showing the saved reservation, stay, total and pending/unpaid state.
Staff booking detail with guest information, stored room items, nights, totals, pending/unpaid status and Edit Booking.
